Product Features

  • Adjustable Headboard: The geometrically shaped, cushioned headboard adds a modern feel to the bedroom. The height of the headboard is adjustable, and the adjustable height range is approximately 10 cm. Different people with different body sizes can find the most comfortable position by adjusting the height of the headboard. The applicable mattress thickness is about 25-35 cm.
  • LED Lighting: The LED lighting adds a modern style to your bedroom, with a remote control you can switch between different colors and intensities for a comfortable lie.
  • Storage design: The single bed is equipped with two drawers, which you can install on the left or right side depending on the room layout. Here, bedspreads and bed sheets find ample space.
  • Practicality meets design: The bed brings elegant design and highest comfort together skillfully. Decorative buttons embellish the headboard and give it a modern touch. The frame of the bed is mainly made of iron, is durable and has a load capacity of up to 300 LBS. The additional support legs of the middle column ensure the reliable stability of the bed.
  • Detailed information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame is shipped in 2 cartons and these can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service. When moving the bed, please lift it instead of dragging it on the floor.
